description:

What's that over there? It looks like it's a fridge, so there's that. You see an oven. You see a table. I guess it's true what they say, if you're looking for a table, go to TextWorld. You see a cookbook on the table. You can make out a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you can make out a raw yellow potato and a knife. You make out a stove. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the stove.
